audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2 through first item were 'Skill' and 2+ items was 'Neeko'; the applied mirror sets rows 1-5 to Neeko and row 6 to Skill. The content whys were also offset by one — whys[1] described level 3, whys[3] described level 6 — so every caption sat against the wrong label.
audit.why: Neeko pokes at 800 and roots at 1000 while Thundering Smash charges 300; she owns every lane stage. At two items Volibear survives the combo but still has to dodge one skillshot, which is 'Skill', not a win.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side and win[0..6] both read Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Neeko, Skill with ratings 3, 3, 4, 4, 3, 4, 5; all seven whys re-aligned to their own label.

audit.why: Her spikes are the level 3-5 poke window, Pop Blossom at 6 and her first item; yours is two items. Captions kept, with the real timers added.
audit.corrected: spikes[3] restated as an even late game rather than a hard flip, matching the corrected row 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated the two mechanics that decide the lane: Tangle-Barbs grows larger, faster and roots LONGER when it first passes through a champion or kills a unit, and Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden while she is disguised by Inherent Glamour.
audit.why: A Volibear standing behind his own minions is feeding the root its upgrade, and a player who thinks he can see the Pop Blossom prep will walk into a stun that had no visible tell.
audit.corrected: Tangle-Barbs: 1000 range, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, and it upgrades on the first thing it passes through. Pop Blossom: 600 range, 120/105/90s, knock-up then stun on landing, prep hidden while disguised. Blooming Burst re-blooms on champion hits, 9s at rank 1. Your Q charges 300 units and Sky Splitter only shields you if you stand in your own blast.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Neeko has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Tangle-Barbs roots from 1000 range and your charge covers 300 — walk up only after she throws it.

edits.before: At level 3 Neeko's bouncing Q and E root let her outpoke and outtrade you.
edits.after: Level 2 is hers: Tangle-Barbs roots at 1000 range and sets up her Q.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Neeko under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sky Splitter slows and shields you inside the blast, but Blooming Burst re-blooms on champion hits — take the poke as chip, not a trade.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 she keeps zoning you with ranged Q and root threat you can't answer.
edits.after: Level 3 stays hers — her Q bounces off the wave and your Q charges 300.

edits.before: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard. Run Neeko down every time Tangle-Barbs is on cooldown — you win the stat-check from here to 6.
edits.after: W ranks make the wounded-bite chunk hard, yet Tangle-Barbs is back every 11s at rank 3 and roots longer if it clips a minion first.

edits.before: Her level 6 Pop Blossom plus root is a burst combo that punishes any careless dive.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are hers — Tangle-Barbs returns every 11s and roots longer on a hit.

edits.before: Stormbringer online — you can dive Neeko under tower with the disable. The 3-6 window is the strongest your lane will ever be: cash it.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables her tower, but Pop Blossom knocks up and stuns as she lands — leap only once her root and her ult are spent.

edits.before: At first item Neeko's magic burst still outranges your engage.
edits.after: Level 6 is hers: Pop Blossom knocks up and stuns everything near.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Neeko to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: Sundered Sky heals on the first hit, but you still have to reach her — commit only when Tangle-Barbs is on its 10-11s timer.

edits.before: With two-plus items your bruiser durability and R let you eat her combo and kill her.
edits.after: First item stays hers — her burst still outranges the 300 units your Q closes.

edits.before: With two items you're a drain-tank Neeko can't burst. Only discipline beats you now — never int the Q stun into ready CC and the lane stays yours.
edits.after: With two items you can eat her combo, but the fight still turns on one skillshot — dodge Tangle-Barbs and she dies, eat it and you do.

edits.before: Late game a fed Volibear diver walks down a squishy mid-game caster once her E is dodged.
edits.after: At 2+ items it is even: dodge Tangle-Barbs and you kill her, eat it and you die.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is even and skill-based before Neeko's poke pattern comes online.
edits.after: Level 1 is hers — Blooming Burst pokes from 800 while you have no reach.

edits.before: This is where you take over. Once you have bruiser items and R uptime, you become a durable diver who eats her squishy combo and kills her in melee. If she wastes Tangle-Barbs, she's dead — mid-game caster falls off against a fed Volibear.
edits.after: This is where it evens out. With bruiser items and Stormbringer up you survive her combo and kill her in melee, but she still opens from range — if she wastes Tangle-Barbs she is dead, and if she lands it you are.

edits.before: With two-plus items you flip the matchup hard. Volibear's bruiser scaling and R durability let you survive her burst and walk her down in melee, and a fed diver crushes a mid-game mage. The whole fight hinges on her Tangle-Barbs: dodge it and she has no self-peel, so you leap in and end her.
edits.after: With two-plus items the fight evens out. Bruiser stats and Stormbringer's bonus Health let you survive her burst, but she still opens at range and Pop Blossom stuns everything around her. It hangs on one skillshot: dodge Tangle-Barbs and she has no self-peel, eat it and her whole rotation lands.

edits.before: You spike levels 3-6 hard — that's the kill window. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.

notes: The content whys[] on this matchup were offset by one label — whys[1] described level 3, whys[3] described level 6, whys[6] described the late game — so even before the side flips, every caption sat under the wrong level. All seven are now written against their own label. Two mechanics that decide the lane and were absent from the page: Tangle-Barbs upgrades (larger, faster, longer root) on the first champion or unit it passes through, so standing behind your own minions feeds it; and Pop Blossom's wind-up is hidden while she is disguised.
